items.exampleEn: I do housework while listening to music.
There is a big pile of ironing on the chair.
items.exampleZh: 椅子上堆著一大堆要燙的衣服。
items.glossZh: 燙衣服（這件事）；待燙的衣物

items.exampleEn: She has untidy hair in the morning.
This duvet is too warm for summer.
items.exampleZh: 這條羽絨被夏天蓋太熱了。

items.exampleEn: Throw the old newspapers in the dustbin.
The office has air conditioning, so it's cool in summer.
items.exampleZh: 辦公室有冷氣，所以夏天很涼快。

items.exampleEn: Put the empty cans in the recycling bin.
Central heating keeps the whole building warm.
items.exampleZh: 中央暖氣讓整棟大樓保持溫暖。

items.sentenceEn: Turn off the air conditioning when you leave.

items.audioEn: My room is untidy, so please wait while I clean it up.
items.audioZh: 我房間很亂，請等我整理一下。

items.sentenceEn: In winter, I sleep under a thick duvet.
items.sentenceZh: 冬天時我蓋厚厚的羽絨被睡覺。

items.sentenceEn: Ironing shirts takes me a long time.
items.sentenceZh: 燙襯衫要花我很多時間。

items.stemEn: Nobody likes doing ____, but someone has to clean the house.
items.stemZh: 沒人喜歡做家事，但總要有人打掃房子。

items.stemEn: The ____ is full; please take it out.
items.stemZh: 垃圾桶滿了，請拿出去倒。

items.passageEn: Our family shares the housework. My father does the ironing, and my mother cleans the kitchen. My job is to empty the dustbin and put the bottles in the recycling bin. My little brother is the problem: his room is always untidy, and his duvet is often on the floor. In summer, we turn on the air conditioning only at night to save money. Our house has no central heating, so in winter we wear our pullovers at home.
items.passageZh: 我們家分擔家事。爸爸負責燙衣服，媽媽打掃廚房。我的工作是倒垃圾，再把瓶子放進回收桶。問題在我弟弟：他的房間總是很亂，羽絨被常常掉在地上。夏天時，我們只在晚上開冷氣，為了省錢。我們家沒有中央暖氣，所以冬天在家都穿著套頭毛衣。

questions.questionZh: 他們家為什麼只在晚上開冷氣？

items.promptZh: 做家事應該是全家人的責任。
referenceEn: Doing housework should be the whole family's job.
Housework should be shared by the whole family.
rubricZh: housework 是不可數名詞，不加 s
「做家事」可寫，例如 do housework、do the housework、do the chores 等
「全家人的責任」可寫 the whole family's job、shared by the whole family 等

items.promptZh: 他的書桌總是很凌亂，上面堆滿了紙。
referenceEn: His desk is always untidy and covered with papers.
His desk is always untidy, with papers all over it.
rubricZh: 用 untidy 表示「凌亂的」（寫 messy 也正確）
「堆滿了紙」可寫，例如 covered with papers、with papers all over it 等
